speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what is the planned capacity increase for patients seeking mental health specialist care by 2030 at (i) IMH and (ii) Alexandra Hospital; and (b) what steps will be taken to support the necessary resources required.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I think many students are very interested to pursue this route.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Could the Senior Minister of State give a little bit more detail about how these training opportunities will trickle down to our learning institutions?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: If I understand Ms Nadia Samdin's question, it is about how the training opportunities will be made available within the learning institutions.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There are a number of institutions that already provide training in psychological and psychiatric services.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Our approach would generally be to work with them to see how we can expand their capacity.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: One of the challenges in this space is that the training of such healthcare workers requires what I call practicums, on-the-job training.
